items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and will be listed as limited.
items.why: Left practice early; Rapoport corroborates limited listing.
items.implication: Monitor Friday report closely; already high-volume post-Adams.
items.opportunity: Heavy target share if plays; TEs/Higbee upside if limited/out.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring (and knee designation); missed Week 6 already.
items.implication: High risk of missing Week 7 vs SEA; Worthy elevated.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy target/snap spike; Royals/Allen secondary.

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to practice Thursday and in line to play Monday vs Cowboys (Berry RB15); efficient in prior full games, strong Dallas matchup.
items.why: Garafolo report; Berry notes efficiency and matchup.
items.implication: Start if active; reverse Pierce beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Heavy workload vs poor DAL run D; Pierce handcuff only.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to unload before deadline.
items.implication: ROS landing spot uncertainty; hold for now.

items.text: Breece Hall back to practice Thursday (limited), first since Week 3 quad injury.
items.why: Jets injury report shows return to practice.
items.implication: Chance to play vs MIA; monitor Friday designation.
items.opportunity: If out, Braelon Allen full lead back.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list, a significant move.
items.why: Full participant recently; Schefter confirms alongside Arroyo season-ending surgery.
items.implication: Likely to play Week 7 vs KC; gradual workload expected.
items.opportunity: Shares with Walker; Walker handcuff value shifts.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in facility meetings/lifting/medical but note MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) poor; OL mess. Discussed long-term on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive but backups inefficient.
items.implication: Jacobs ROS value intact if returns; fade pure backups.
items.opportunity: Jacobs volume when back; limited handcuff appeal.

items.text: Notable Ferguson IR recovery delay (not ready soon); Rams only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams.
items.opportunity: 25-tgt pace; TE personnel heavy but Puka primary.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): back in real role, 33% target share, 97% routes Week 6 despite drops; Bears good yardage spot.
Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11): elite volume.
Loves Jaylen Warren @ NO (RB9), Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10), Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups.
Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) workload questions post-layoff; Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37) brutal spot.
items.conflict: Levitan more constructive on Jacobs facility access.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9) due to nasty matchups and roles.
JJ McCarthy YPT to Justin Jefferson only 5.7 vs prior QBs 9.9-10.8; different scheme/coaches/small sample but hard to ignore. Giants plan to start McCarthy.
items.opportunity: Volume still there but YAC/efficiency risk.
